data_source.detail: spaCR Measure cell crops (cell-masked, per-crop 0-100 percentile normalised) placed back at their measured positions; display stretch 0.5-99.7 percentile per channel. Uninfected cells and background were not cropped (include_uninfected False), so they are black; cells larger than 224 px are clipped square.

steps.caption: Masks: cell (yellow), nucleus (cyan) and parasite (magenta) outlines on the same field.

data_source.dataset: HF dataset einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen, plate1-data.tar (224 px cell_png crops); HF dataset einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit (plate 1 cut of spacr-example-screen) measurements/measurements.db
data_source.detail: Cell outlines are the exact spaCR cell masks carried by the crops. Nucleus (21) and parasite (35) objects were recomputed on CPU with Cellpose-SAM (cpsam) on the reassembled planes, keeping objects at or above spaCR's Measure min sizes (nucleus 2000 px, pathogen 500 px), because the dataset ships no mask images; they are not the screen's original masks, and the magenta objects are parasite clusters/vacuoles.

steps.spacr_function: spacr.deep_spacr._vs_default_segment(device="cpu") (Cellpose cpsam) for nucleus/parasite; cell masks from spacr.measure crops
